note: Performance & Rewards → Performance. SmartPRS 2 stored one 1-5 rating per employee per cycle; here a review carries a self rating, a manager rating and a final rating on the scale below. The reviewer is the employee's reporting manager from the employee record. The final rating defaults to the manager's rating (`final_defaults_to`) and HR may override it when finalising.

periods.note: The review cycles offered. A cycle is a label; `kind` says how the offered labels are generated from today's date.

prg.note: Performance-related growth: the final rating maps to a recommended increment band, which the Increments register (compensation) reads as a suggestion, never as an instruction.
